##2QC

```{r}



#check the threshold before
hist(
  colSums(counts(sce) > 0),
  breaks = 100,
  main = "Detected genes per cell",
  xlab = "Number of genes"
)

# basic filters
sce <- scater::addPerCellQC(sce)
min.features <- 500
min.cells <- 5

qc <- scater::perCellQCMetrics(sce)
sce <- sce[rowSums(counts(sce) >= 1) >= min.cells, ]
sce <- sce[, colSums(counts(sce) >= 1) >= min.features]


#mt
is.mito <- grep("MT-", rownames(sce))
per.cell <- scuttle::perCellQCMetrics(sce, subsets=list(Mito=is.mito))
colData(sce)[['subsets_Mito_percent']] <- per.cell$subsets_Mito_percent

class(colData(sce)$subsets_Mito_percent)
hist(
  colData(sce)$subsets_Mito_percent,
  breaks = 100,
  main = "Mitochondrial percentage per cell",
  xlab = "Percent mitochondrial reads"
)
sce <- sce[, colData(sce)$subsets_Mito_percent < 15]
rm(RA)

```



##3Normalization
```{r}
#---
scale.factor <- 1e4
lib.sizes <- colSums(counts(sce)) / scale.factor
assay(sce, 'logcounts') <- scuttle::normalizeCounts(sce, size.factors=lib.sizes, log=FALSE, center.size.factors=FALSE)
assay(sce, 'logcounts') <- log1p(assay(sce, 'logcounts'))
head(colData(sce))

```






```{r}
#-----run liliana
liana_res <- liana_bysample( sce = sce,
                      sample_col = "sample", # context dimension column from SCE metadata
                      idents_col = "CellType", # cell types column from SCE metadata
                      resource = 'Consensus',
                      expr_prop = 0.1, # must be expressed in expr_prop fraction of cells
                      min_cells = 5,
                      assay.type = 'logcounts', # run on log- and library-normalized counts
                      aggregate_how = 'both', # aggregate magnitude and specificity
                      verbose = TRUE,
                      inplace = FALSE, #save it out of the sce obj
                      permutation.params=list(nperms=100),
                      return_all=TRUE
                      )
#we convert to data frame 

names(liana_res) <- unique(colData(sce)$sample) #all sample name 
library(dplyr)
liana_res <-bind_rows(liana_res, .id = "sample")
liana_res$sample <- as.character(liana_res$sample)
table(liana_res$sample)
write.csv(liana_res, file = "CCC/RA/output/liana_res.csv", row.names = FALSE)


# Filter strong interactions

liana_filt <- liana_res %>%
  filter(magnitude_rank <= 0.05,
         cellphonedb.pvalue <= 0.01)
  table(liana_filt$sample)   
  write.csv(liana_filt, file = "CCC/RA/output/liana_filt.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  #
 liana_filt=read.csv("CCC/RA/output/liana_filt.csv")
 liana_res=read.csv("CCC/RA/output/liana_res.csv")
```

##4Top senders and receivers
```{r}

#1 sender and receivers
sender_df <- liana_filt %>%
  dplyr::count(source, name = "source_count") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(celltype_clust = source) 

receiver_df <- liana_filt %>% 
  dplyr::count(target, name = "target_count") %>%
  dplyr::rename(celltype_clust = target) 

activity_df <- full_join(sender_df, receiver_df,
              by = "celltype_clust") %>%
              replace_na(list(source_count = 0,
                target_count = 0))          
           

```


```{r}

#2 compute total_count
activity_df <- activity_df %>%
  mutate(
    total_count = source_count + target_count,
    sender_rank = rank(-source_count, ties.method = "min"),
    receiver_rank = rank(-target_count, ties.method = "min")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_count))

write.csv(activity_df,file = "CCC/RA/output/Top_sender_receivers.csv",row.names = FALSE)


```



```{r}

#3 rank
activity_df <- activity_df %>%
  arrange(desc(total_count))

activity_df$celltype_clust <- factor(activity_df$celltype_clust,
                                     levels = rev(unique(activity_df$celltype_clust)))
#plot

#4 plot
plot_df <- activity_df %>%
  select(celltype_clust, source_count, target_count, total_count) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(source_count, target_count),
               names_to = "role",
               values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(role = recode(role,
                       source_count = "source",
                       target_count = "target"),
         role = factor(role, levels = c("source", "target")))


 p <- ggplot(plot_df,
            aes(x = count, y = celltype_clust, fill = role)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE), width = 0.65) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = NULL,
                    values = c("source" = "#2166AC", "target" = "#D6604D"),
                    labels = c("Sender", "Receiver")) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = "Number of interactions",
       y = NULL
       ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.85, 0.15),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13, margin = margin(t = 8)),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 10)
  )   

#save
ggsave(filename = "CCC/RA/output/TopSR.pdf", plot = p, width = 10, height = 8,dpi = 300)
```

##5Unique and shared ligand-Receptor

```{r}

#1 unique LR
unique_lr <- liana_filt %>%
  dplyr::mutate(LR_pair = paste(ligand.complex, receptor.complex, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(LR_pair) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() == 1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(source, target, ligand.complex, receptor.complex, LR_pair,
                magnitude_rank, cellphonedb.pvalue, specificity_rank, magnitude_mean_rank) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(magnitude_rank)
write.csv(unique_lr, file = "CCC/RA/output/Unique_lr.csv", row.names = TRUE)

#2 shared LR
shared_lr <- liana_filt %>%
  dplyr::mutate(LR_pair = paste(ligand.complex, receptor.complex, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(LR_pair) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(n_repetitions = dplyr::n()) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_repetitions > 1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(source, target, ligand.complex, receptor.complex, LR_pair,
                n_repetitions, magnitude_rank, cellphonedb.pvalue,
                specificity_rank, magnitude_mean_rank)
write.csv(shared_lr, file = "CCC/RA/output/shared_lr.csv", row.names = TRUE)

```





```{r}
#---plot-shared---
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. LR_pair already exists in shared_lr from chunk #2 — safe to leave, just namespaced
shared_lr <- shared_lr %>%
  dplyr::mutate(LR_pair = paste(ligand.complex, receptor.complex, sep = "_"))

# 2. Filter by source cell
source_cell <- "Fibroblasts_1"
shared_source <- shared_lr %>%
  dplyr::filter(source == source_cell)

# 3. Keep shared interactions (multiple targets)
shared_source_clean <- shared_source %>%
  dplyr::group_by(LR_pair) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(target) >= 3) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# 4. Select TOP LR pairs
top_lr_pairs <- shared_source_clean %>%
  dplyr::group_by(LR_pair) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_rank = mean(magnitude_mean_rank, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(mean_rank) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  dplyr::pull(LR_pair)

# 5. Keep ALL rows for these LR pairs
shared_source_top <- shared_source_clean %>%
  dplyr::filter(LR_pair %in% top_lr_pairs)

# 6. Plot
p <- ggplot(shared_source_top,
            aes(x = LR_pair, y = target)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = -magnitude_mean_rank,
                 color = -magnitude_mean_rank)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Interaction\nstrength",
                        option = "plasma",
                        guide = guide_colorbar(
                          barwidth = 1,
                          barheight = 8,
                          ticks = TRUE,
                          ticks.colour = "white",
                          frame.colour = "grey50"
                        )) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Interaction\nstrength",
                        range = c(2, 8),
                        guide = "none") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = paste(source_cell, "as Sender"),
    y = "Receivers"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1,
                                size = 16, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, margin = margin(r = 8)),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 10)
  )

ggsave(filename = "CCC/RA/output/shared_lr.pdf", plot = p, width = 20, height = 20, dpi = 300)

```

##6Pathway
```{r}



#-----Pathway enrichment using gprofiler2-----
library(gprofiler2)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Extract ligand and receptor genes from liana_filt (query)
ligands_strong <- liana_filt$ligand.complex
ligands_strong <- ligands_strong[!is.na(ligands_strong)]
receptors_strong <- liana_filt$receptor.complex
receptors_strong <- receptors_strong[!is.na(receptors_strong)]
query_genes <- unique(c(ligands_strong, receptors_strong))
length(query_genes)

# 2. Extract ligand and receptor genes from liana_res (background)
ligands_all <- liana_res$ligand.complex
ligands_all <- ligands_all[!is.na(ligands_all)]
receptors_all <- liana_res$receptor.complex
receptors_all <- receptors_all[!is.na(receptors_all)]
background_genes <- unique(c(ligands_all, receptors_all))
length(background_genes)

# 3. Perform ORA using g:Profiler
gprof_enr <- gost(
  query = query_genes,
  ordered_query = FALSE,
  custom_bg = background_genes,
  organism = "hsapiens"
)

# 4. Clean results
gprof_results_clean <- gprof_enr$result
nrow(gprof_results_clean)
gprof_results_clean$parents <- NULL
gprof_results_clean <- gprof_results_clean[order(gprof_results_clean$p_value), ]

# Save all results
write.csv(gprof_results_clean, "CCC/RA/output/Pathways.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 5. Filter for GO:BP and Reactome
gprof_GO <- gprof_results_clean %>%
  filter(source %in% c("GO:BP", "REAC")) %>%
  filter(term_size < 500) %>%
  filter(intersection_size >= 3) %>%
  arrange(p_value)

write.csv(gprof_GO, "CCC/RA/output/PathwaysGO.csv", row.names = FALSE)


```




```{r}
#-----Plot pathway enrichment-----
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Select top pathways
top_pathways <- gprof_GO %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    term_name = factor(term_name,
                       levels = rev(unique(term_name))),
    log10p = -log10(p_value)
  )

# 2. Plot
p <- ggplot(top_pathways,
            aes(x = log10p,
                y = term_name,
                fill = source)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey40",
             linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Database",
                    values = c("GO:BP" = "#2166AC",
                               "REAC"  = "#D6604D")) +
  facet_wrap(~ source, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Pathway Enrichment",
    x = "-log10(p-value)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(t = 8)),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 10)
  )



ggsave(filename = "CCC/RA/output/Pathways.png", plot = p,width = 10, height = 14, dpi = 300)
ggsave(filename = "CCC/RA/output/Pathways.pdf", plot = p,width = 10, height = 14, dpi = 300)


 
```

##8,GRN plots
```{r}
#---Plot RSS from rss_cellType.csv---
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# 1. Load RSS file
rss <- read.csv("GRN_SCENIC/RA/output/rss_cellType.csv", row.names = 1)

# 2. Convert to long format
rss_long <- rss %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("regulon") %>%
  pivot_longer(-regulon,
               names_to = "cell_type",
               values_to = "RSS")

# 3. Select top 5 regulons per cell type
top_regulons <- rss_long %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  arrange(desc(RSS)) %>%
  slice_head(n =) %>%
  ungroup()

# 4. Plot
p <- ggplot(top_regulons,
            aes(x = RSS,
                y = reorder(regulon, RSS),
                fill = cell_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ cell_type, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma", guide = "none") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Top Regulons per Cell Type (RSS)",
    x = "Regulon Specificity Score",
    y = "Regulon (TF)"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 10)
  )

p

ggsave(filename = "GRN_SCENIC/RSS_top_regulons.png", plot = p,
       width = 20, height = 20, dpi = 300)
```
